activity.weekly_minutes_rule: No: zero only when follow-up values are absent; Yes: days times minutes when days are 1-7 and minutes are at least 10 and below 1440; otherwise null
activity.wording_note: 2011-2012 participation wording lacks the explicit typical-week phrase used in later cycles

period_history.note: Does not measure cycle regularity or menstrual phase

pregnancy.note: Age eligibility does not guarantee the question was asked; retain missing values and raw responses
